gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-resend-witness: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-resend-witness: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-resend-witness: 16.3: 'When the first request returned null, QMUX released its key, so the resend was accepted and sent. It has the same key, so the first attempt's approval, arriving at 1.5 seconds, matched the resend... The host received two purchases and approved both.' Output shows 'retrying: APPROVED' and two 0200s with 11=000301.
recorded.prompt:q-proxy-wait: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-proxy-wait: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-proxy-wait: 16.4.1, RecordingProxy at 1000 ms: '(2) it left... nothing sent to the client'; output 'client 000402: null at 3000 ms', approval on upstream-unhandled; 'The client now reverses... A purchase that would have gone through became a reversal. ... the proxy must wait at least as long.' Same scenario with 8 s/12 s/20 s.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-proxy-key: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-proxy-key: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shared-proxy-key: 16.4.2: 'Duplicate key ... detected'; 'The proxy's QMUX builds its key from the MTI and fields 41 and 11 ... It refused the second request, and the proxy logged the exception and sent nothing. The second tester sees a host that didn't answer.'
recorded.prompt:q-first-failure: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-first-failure: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-first-failure: 16.5 opening: 'A test that asserts field by field stops at the first failure. A grader that collects every difference reports them all in one run.'

recorded.prompt:q-resend-witness:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-resend-witness:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-resend-witness:b: 16.3: 'The host received two purchases and approved both' refutes one purchase; the 'host saw 0200 ... 0200' output shows both reached it.
recorded.prompt:q-resend-witness:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-resend-witness:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-resend-witness:c: 16.3: the first attempt's approval 'matched the resend, which was still waiting'; the client reports APPROVED.
recorded.prompt:q-resend-witness:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-resend-witness:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-resend-witness:d: 16.3: 'QMUX released its key, so the resend was accepted and sent.'
recorded.prompt:q-proxy-wait:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-proxy-wait:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-proxy-wait:a: 16.4.1: the approval 'came at 1.5 seconds, while the client was still waiting, but after the proxy had given up', and it shows on 'upstream-unhandled', not at the client.
recorded.prompt:q-proxy-wait:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-proxy-wait:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-proxy-wait:b: 16.4.1: the proxy's own 'timeout' property bounds mux.request, and the 1000 ms/3000 ms run shows the client's longer wait did not keep it open; 'the proxy must wait at least as long' (short inference).
recorded.prompt:q-proxy-wait:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-proxy-wait:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-proxy-wait:d: 16.4.1: after the proxy gave up the host still approved ('upstream-unhandled: 0210 11=000402 39=00'); the proxy giving up does not change the host's answer.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-proxy-key:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-proxy-key:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shared-proxy-key:b: 16.4.2: the second request with the same key is refused (Duplicate key), so it never waits to receive the other's answer.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-proxy-key:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-proxy-key:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shared-proxy-key:c: 16.4.2: the QMUX 'can't tell the two clients apart' and the second client got 'nothing within 3000 ms'.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-proxy-key:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-proxy-key:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-shared-proxy-key:d: 16.4.2: the refusal happens at the proxy's QMUX before anything is sent upstream, so host behaviour cannot rescue it; the page's fix is distinct terminal IDs or one proxy per client (short inference).
recorded.prompt:q-first-failure:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-first-failure:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-first-failure:b: 16.5: the grader checks what the case expects; the 'wrong expectation' row reports '38: expected a value, got none' on a decline, so a missing 38 counts when the case expects it.
recorded.prompt:q-first-failure:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-first-failure:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-first-failure:c: 16.5: 'A test that asserts field by field stops at the first failure.'
recorded.prompt:q-first-failure:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-first-failure:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-first-failure:d: 16.5: same sentence; the test does not go on after the first failure.
